An '''individual''' was the first [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Daakman Barrek]] and served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Their [[Jedi Master/Legends|master]] successfully [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] them to Knighthood and later took on a new Padawan, [[Sha'a Gi]].<ref name="Databank" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Knight was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] at the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Databank" /> a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Barrek was saddened to receive word of his first Padawan's death at Geonosis while training Gi, subsequently committing himself fully to the war effort.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Daakman Barrek's first Padawan was mentioned in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Daakman Barrek on [[StarWars.com]], which was published by [[2004]].<ref name="Databank" />
